_comment: EXAMPLE row manifest for the k6 proof-harness. Describes the rows a run will
fire/observe and the receipts each row expects. The post-processor reads this
plus each scenario's summary.json to author PROOFS/<SHA>/<ROW>/ artifacts.
SECURITY: this file carries NO token. The gateway token comes from the
OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN env var (loopback/tailnet only) or a CI repo-secret.
Never put a token in a manifest or any committed artifact.
safeToFire: a row only fires its continuation tool when BOTH this flag AND the
SAFE_TO_FIRE=1 env gate are set. Default OFF — scaffold-safe. preflight is
⚠️ Verify gateway method/tool names against the DEPLOYED SHA before a real run
(the names below come from the design notes, not yet byte-verified live).

rows._safeNote: read-only inventory; no continuation is fired
expectedReceipts: per-tool visibility label for continue_work / continue_delegate / request_compaction
rows.passCandidateRule: all expected continuation tools visible (or absent-classified as HONEST-LIMIT per surface)

expectedReceipts: successor turn observed after current turn
trace id captured -> wake_event_trace.json (fetch from Tempo in post-process)
rows.passCandidateRule: accepted AND successorTurnObserved AND chainCorrelated; ERRONEOUS = 0 turns or >1

rows._sessionNote: target a dedicated test session — this injects a driving prompt
expectedReceipts: hop-2 turn fired from the parsed bare CONTINUE_WORK:1 token
hop-2 reply carried the nonce (PROOF-HOP2 <nonce>) -> proves it DROVE, not just stripped
task-ledger entry (tasks.list shows the delegate/background task)
child session key or run id
trace showing dispatch -> child run stitch -> task-ledger.json
rows.passCandidateRule: accepted AND taskLedgerEntry AND childKeyOrRunId AND parentReturnObserved

rows._sessionNote: target a dedicated test session — this injects a bracket-driving prompt
expectedReceipts: child run created from the parsed [[CONTINUE_DELEGATE: ... | silent-wake]] bracket

_notIncludedFirstMilestone._comment: Deferred per notes 'Recommended first milestone' — add one at a time, serialized, after the 5 smokes are stable.
rows: R-RC-1 / R-RC-2 (request_compaction — TOOL-ONLY, no token form; opt-in + serialized; never parallel with cw/cd against the same session)
